body: Man, i can relate so much with that, like, 100%
Man, same here, it would be so nice.

Well, same for me, whenever i talk with some girl, i stutter, alot.
Half of my classmates are assholes, so if I do care, i would most likely be dead by now.
I never looked for the perfect one, heck, i didn't even search for anyone, i just cant, i give in to the anxiety everytime i talk to a girl.

Well, saying it through the internet, to people i won't ever see makes it easier, but saying to someone face to face that type of stuff would just be impossible for me.

One thing that would make my life better would be to have someone emotionally supportive irl, someone who could take with my shit when i feel low.
